meta.name: brainstorm-experiments-new
meta.description: Design lean startup experiments (pretotypes) for a new product. Creates XYZ hypotheses and suggests low-effort validation methods like landing pages, explainer videos, and pre-orders. Use when validating a new product idea, creating pretotypes, or testing market demand.

copy.tagline: 用精益实验快速验证新产品想法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构思新产品，想用最小成本验证市场需求。
copy.tagline_en: Validate new product ideas with lean experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are brainstorming a new product and want to test demand with minimal effort.

howto.what: 当你提出一个新产品的想法时，它会帮你设计精益创业实验（预原型），生成一个XYZ假设，并建议用落地页、讲解视频等低成本方法来验证。
howto.when: 当你需要验证一个新产品的想法、创建预原型或测试市场需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新产品设计一个XYZ假设和验证实验。
say.note: 它会生成假设并建议实验方法。

say.text: 我想测试一个针对年轻父母的育儿App，该怎么做预原型？
say.note: 它会根据你的描述设计具体实验。

howto.what_en: When you propose a new product idea, it designs lean startup experiments (pretotypes), creates an XYZ hypothesis, and suggests low-effort validation methods like landing pages and explainer videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate a new product idea, create a pretotype, or test market demand.

say_en.text: Design an XYZ hypothesis and validation experiments for this new product.
say_en.note: It will generate a hypothesis and suggest experiments.

say_en.text: I want to test a parenting app for young parents. How to create a pretotype?
say_en.note: It will design specific experiments based on your description.
